notes.title: AV-17 v1.0.0.4 Minor Update
notes.notes:
Hello All,

I discovered that after a recent game maker studio 2 update one of the enemy objects code was automatically modified (not in a good way). The AV Red enemy (basically your evil twin) would generate a game ending error after spawning and teleporting for the first time. This issue has been resolved in this update. Sorry for anyone that experienced the issue.

And since I was at it, I figured I would also make the following quick changes:

- [b]ALL Bosses health has been reduced by about 15%[/b]
- The last two cars of the Deadly Driver boss now drop loot after being destroyed. This was the only boss (other than the last boss) that did not drop loop after being defeated. 

Hopefully these minor changes even the odds. :)

Thanks,
WANZUNGDEV

notes.title: AV-17 v1.0.0.3 Update
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

Hope you are enjoying the start to a new year! It has been a pleasure hearing all the feedback provided over the last couple months. A special thanks to all those that uploaded pictures, posted on YoutTube, and even to kairu209 for making some fun fan art! Glad most people have enjoyed their time with AV-17, if only for curiosity sake.

Well, without further delay here are a few updates/fixes that I made this evening:

- Fixed an issue where the meteor item did not kill green network spikes in section 2, just produced hit pixels if roaming low to the ground
- Fixed meteor item so that it now explodes when hitting the floor causing a screen shake and noise
- Fixed an issue where the fish mailer in section 1 of the game would not track player 2 if player 1 was not in the game
- Fixed an issue where the fish mailer v2 in section 3 of the game would not track player 2 if player 1 was not in the game
- Extended the length of time items remain visible before disappearing from 5 to 8 seconds
- Extended the time between changing rooms from 3 to 8 seconds to allow for players to pick up items, especially after boss fights

Thanks again for your feedback. I am looking to add up to 5 new infection enemies into the game sometime this year. As usual, I have no ETA, but it is something that I want to do to spice things up.

Take Care,
WANZUNGDEV

notes.title: AV-17 v1.0.0.2 Quick Update
notes.notes:
Hi Again,

I know, so soon! I wanted to make a couple quick updates to the game this weekend. Here they are:

1. You can now play AV-17 in Dual Core (two player) mode with player 1 using the keyboard and player 2 using the gamepad. You no longer need two gamepads to make two player work. 

2. You can now use the left CTRL or SPACE keys to perform the dash move. More alternatives the better.

3. The README file has been updated with the info above.

I want to thank everyone again for their feedback. 

Thanks,
WANZUNGDEV
